text:
Priya Shah: noticed a flurry of schema errors in the sampleapp when using JSON mode + streaming fncalls after the streaming endpoint upgrade.
Tom Reed: can you share the error snippet? likely parsing partial chunks.
Priya Shah: paste: 
``
[data] '{"call": {"name":"search","args": {"q": "x","docs": ['
[data] '"a","b","c"]}}'
validator: SyntaxError: Unexpected end of JSON input
```
Priya Shah: SDK validator is being applied to each data event; streaming emits fragments.
Elena Korolev: short-term: add an SDK helper that assembles a top-level JSON value before parsing. call it `jsonFrameCollector` or `collectTopLevelJson`.
Noah Brooks: agree. needs safety caps: maxBytes (128KB default) and maxWaitMs (200ms default). if exceeded emit a `partial` frame with truncated=true so apps can decide.
Tom Reed: parity: node should expose async iterator/stream wrapper; python should expose same name and semantics (async generator yielding frames).
Elena Korolev: tests: nested arrays, strings with escaped braces, NDJSON within tool outputs, concatenated objects. add fuzzing for random chunk boundaries.
Priya Shah: also add an opt-in mode that exposes tokens immediately (low-latency) while collector assembles background full-object for validation. useful for apps that need partial rendering + schema check.
Noah Brooks: telemetry: emit `sdk.jsonframe.size`, `sdk.jsonframe.latency_ms`, and `sdk.jsonframe.mode` to tune defaults after rollout.
Tom Reed: docs: update sampleapp onboarding with a short how-to and example using fncall where tool returns streamed JSON. mention caveats and fallback to non-streaming call.
Priya Shah: I'll prototype TS helper and open draft PR behind a feature flag. Elena can take python mirror.
Elena Korolev: taking python follow-up. will add integration test in sampleapp harness.
devex-bot: created issue #8602: "SDK json-frame collector + parity + telemetry"
Priya Shah: checklist before merge: unit tests, node+py parity, sampleapp docs, telemetry, feature flag. planning to push draft to dev behind flag by EOD.
Tom Reed: LGTM.
